statusLine.command: input=$(cat); if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); effort=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); else model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | grep -o '"display_name":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); effort=""; fi; if [ -n "$effort" ]; then printf '%s | effort: %s\n' "$model" "$effort"; else printf '%s\n' "$model"; fi
